bronxville!! five bedrooms, would look SO good with a wreath on the door.

items.title: the bicep heart
items.body: flex one arm, then curl your other hand against it to make a heart. it started at the gym in late october and now everyone's doing it, some seriously, some as a joke.

items.title: "why would I deceive you?"
items.body: it's Elizabeth Holmes's line to Nathan Fielder in the A24 doc trailer, and now people use it for anything that seems too good to be true. SNL even did it!!

items.title: "first time in a fancy cafe"
items.body: AI meme clips of people sitting ON a steel table that looks like a stool while someone else uses it as a table. now it's any furniture in a weird spot. so dumb, i love it.

items.title: "chopped"
items.body: means something's unattractive or not cool. NOT the same as "cooked" (which means you're doomed). very important difference apparently.

items.title: "mid"
items.body: for when you expected something great and it was just... average. "the new season is mid."

items.title: "ratio'd"
items.body: when a post gets totally buried by negative replies. basically getting called out online.

items.title: "quiet on the creek"
items.body: means keeping something to yourself, especially a new relationship. it's from a story Saucy Santana told about fishing.
